verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance documents a broad public REST API covering account ownership, balances, transactions, ACH details and reports. It has token-based auth using Partner ID, secret and appKey, plus webhooks and a free, unlimited Test Drive sandbox with test personas and banks. A first-party OpenAPI spec on GitHub supports generating client libraries, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end, since all evidence is first-party.
